group_name: Pack Memorial Library Teen Dungeons & Dragons
summary: A biweekly teen (ages 13-17) D&D session run by library staff member Raj at Pack Memorial Library's Buncombe County Special Collections, open to any eligible teen who emails to register for a seat. There is no membership language, named recurring players, or outside community page (Discord, Facebook group, Meetup) - it reads as a standard library youth program rather than a self-identified club.

evidence.note: Listing frames it as an open call ('Calling all adventurous teens!') for any player aged 13-17, not a closed party of returning members.
Registration is a simple email sign-up to Raj to reserve a spot, consistent with capacity-limited library program registration rather than joining a persistent club or roster.
Both sessions are organized/run by Buncombe County Special Collections staff (Raj), a library employee, not a volunteer-led community group.
No description text mentions a continuing campaign storyline, named regular players, dues, or any outside community channel (Discord/Facebook/Meetup).

WebFetch attempts at guessed Buncombe County Library program pages (post-domain-migration to buncombenc.gov) returned 404s; WebSearch was unavailable due to session search budget exhaustion, so no independent web presence could be confirmed either way.
